text:
maria: Heads-up: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4523 — changes to how secrets are scoped for Private deployments + a small VPC route tweak. Need security eyes before merge window tomorrow morning.
kai: linking to PR, thanks. what specifically changed for secrets? is this introducing a new KMS usage pattern?
maria: short: we move tenant secrets from shared vault path to tenant-scoped paths and add a policy binding to allow on-prem HSM key use for the tenant key. also we adjusted routing so private control plane can talk to on-prem collector via the new peered subnet.
jamal: :eyes: can you paste the terraform snippet for the route and the IAM binding? I want to confirm no wide CIDR opened.
maria: sure, snippet from the PR:
```
resource "aws_route" "to_onprem" {
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.private_rt.id
  destination_cidr_block = var.onprem_cidr
  vpc_peering_connection_id = aws_vpc_peering.pc.id
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "tenant" {
  description = "tenant scoped key"
  key_usage = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
  policy = file("policies/tenant-kms-policy.json")
}
```
security-bot: SECURITY-CHECK: missing threat-model.md note. secrets-scope change requires HSM usage justification + audit plan. See checklist: secrets-scoped, kms-usage, audit-logs.
maria: adding threat-model.md to the PR now. added preliminary justification and audit steps. will link after push.
sara: pinged. I'll need the HSM team sign-off for using external HSM for tenant keys. Also we need a short note on backup/export controls and access reviews. Please add.
maria: noted — added export-protection section and reviewers tag @hsm-team. Also set private flag so the PR isn't auto-merged until approvals.
jamal: I looked at the route snippet — var.onprem_cidr is fine but current value was broad. please tighten to the specific aggregator IP range (10.52.8.0/24). can you change and run terraform plan?
maria: updated var and pushed plan output to PR. terraform plan shows no destructive changes.
deploy-bot: CI: integration-tests failed on 3 tests (secret-rotation, kv-cache, route-probe). See https://ci.internal/12345 for logs.
maria: re-ran flaky tests locally. found a race in the route-probe harness. pushed a small fix and a test flake skip for the infra-harness until we stabilize.
kai: thanks — can security do a quick read while I review code-level changes? I'm blocked on unit test flakiness but can review after green.
sara: quick read done. CLA/PCI notes good. I need a final HSM sign-off before I give formal approval. leaving inline comments on the PR for the backup/export controls.
security-bot: AUTO: all required labels present: secrets-scope, vpc-change, private-deploy. Approval gating set: hsm-signoff required.
maria: @hsm-team any ETA on sign-off? we want to merge in the 09:00 UTC release window tomorrow.
hsm-team: (via @hsm-team) we can do a short review today — will confirm by EOD. checklist: key usage patterns, no external export, rotation policy.
jamal: also add a rollout plan note: enable tenant-scoped keys for a single canary account first, monitor audit logs for 24h, then gradual rollout. put it in PR description.
maria: added canary rollout steps and monitoring dashboard links.
deploy-bot: CI: integration-tests now GREEN. e2e still running.
kai: reviewed code, left one minor nit (inline comment). overall LGTM from infra perspective once tests green.
sara: HSM sign-off: approved with conditions (no key export, rotation every 90d, audit alerting on admin key use). leaving formal comment on PR. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks @sara and @hsm-team. I removed export perms, added rotation policy, updated audit alerting rules.
security-bot: FINAL-CHECK: required approvals: hsm-signoff, sec-lead. All present. gating lifted.
maria: CI all green (unit + integration + e2e). merging now. :shipit:
jamal: please post the small migration command and the verification steps in #deploys after merge.
maria: migration command: `./scripts/migrate-tenants --tenant canary-101 --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd1234 --dry-run=false` and verification: check audit log stream `tenant-canary-101` for key usage and route-probe dashboard for connectivity. Will post to #deploys.
deploy-bot: MERGE: PR #4523 merged by maria at 1918001289. release window: scheduled 09:00 UTC.
kai: nice, thanks all.
maria: thanks everyone — will follow up in #deploys with post-merge verification. :rocket:
